auth.userBody: No password. A code to your inbox, and the seat is in your name.
auth.staffBody: Staff and companies sign in here. Your role decides what you see: courses, payments, team, or private requests.
auth.companyBody: Request a private edition from the same team portal.
auth.profileHint: We open your profile with this email.
auth.companyRegisterHint: If your company is not on DOMINA yet, register it here. Operations staff enter by invite.
auth.reserveBody: We check your email for an existing profile. First time here? We open one in this short form.
auth.formSubtitleEmail: We’ll email a one-time code. No password to remember.
auth.formSubtitleProfile: First time here — tell us your name and we open your seat.
auth.staffFormSubtitle: Operations and company buyers use the same door.
auth.testimonial1Quote: I left with a dashboard I could show at work the next morning.

account.title: Your practice
account.none: You do not have a seat yet. Pick a course and reserve.
account.languageHint: Saved on your profile and applied when you sign in.
account.feedbackHint: Rate the workshop you just practiced.
account.celebrateTitle: You're in. Now make it count.
account.celebrateLead: Payment cleared. Your seat is locked — show up ready to practice.
account.myCoursesBody: Every seat you booked — paid, pending, or ready for the room.
account.myCoursesEmpty: No seats yet. The catalog is open.

quotes.1: Skill is built in the room, not in the intention. You just chose the room.
quotes.2: The next version of you is already waiting behind one focused practice.
quotes.3: Courage is booking the seat. Mastery is showing up and doing the work.
quotes.4: You don't need more motivation. You need this practice — and you just paid for it.
quotes.5: Progress loves a deadline and a desk. Yours is set. Own the day.

pay.title: Confirm your seat
pay.body: Pay by card, OXXO, or bank transfer. DOMINA never stores payment details.
pay.missing: Payments are not configured in this environment yet.
pay.includesSeat: One seat in your name for this edition.
pay.bulletOxxo: OXXO: pay cash in store (voucher valid 3 days).
pay.bulletTransfer: SPEI transfer: send the exact amount with the concept code; we confirm your seat.
pay.couponFreeBody: Card, OXXO, and bank transfer are hidden because the total is $0. Confirm below to lock your seat.
pay.transferPendingBody: Send a SPEI with the exact amount. Use the concept below so we can match your payment.
pay.transferConceptLegend: What to write in the concept
pay.transferConceptBody: Type exactly {{reference}} in the SPEI concept field. Without this code we cannot match your transfer.
pay.transferStep1: Open your bank app and start a SPEI to the CLABE above.
pay.transferStep3: After you send it, wait for our team to confirm — then your seat is locked.
pay.transferSwitchMethod: Pay with card or OXXO instead
pay.oxxoPendingBody: Pay at any OXXO with the Stripe voucher. Once cash clears, your seat is marked paid.
pay.oxxoStayBody: We emailed the barcode (valid 3 days). Payment methods stay open below — use card if you prefer, and avoid paying twice.
pay.oxxoStayHint: Closed the voucher by accident? Open the Stripe email or resend our branded voucher below.
pay.oxxoModalLead: Show this voucher at the cashier. We can also email it to you.
pay.oxxoStep1: Hand the barcode to the cashier to scan.
pay.oxxoStep2: Pay the exact amount in cash.
pay.oxxoStep3: Keep the receipt — your seat marks paid when cash clears.
pay.notFound: This payment link is invalid or belongs to another account.
pay.unavailable: This seat is no longer available for payment.

admin.couponsBody: Create DOMINA-owned codes for percent or fixed MXN discounts. Learners apply them on the pay page.
admin.couponsDenied: Only owners and finance can manage coupons.
admin.transfersBody: Confirm or reject SPEI payments waiting on bank settlement. Edit the CLABE learners see at checkout.
admin.transfersForbidden: Only owners, finance, and coordinators can manage transfers.
admin.searchTransfers: Search by name, email, course, or concept
admin.transferRejectPrompt: Optional reason for the learner / audit log
admin.bankSettingsBody: These details appear when someone chooses Transferencia. Update them when your CLABE changes.
admin.bankExpiresDays: Days before a pending transfer expires
admin.instructorsBody: Invite workshop instructors and assign them to editions. They get a welcome email and live alerts when seats are paid.
admin.instructorsForbidden: Only owners and coordinators can manage instructors.
admin.inviteInstructorBody: Sends a welcome email with the team access door. No password — OTP only.
admin.instructorPickerHint: Search filters the list. Pick one instructor per edition.
admin.myEditionsBody: Editions assigned to you. Open one to see paid participants.
admin.myRosterBody: Learners who paid for this edition.
admin.coursesBody: Publish workshops, prices, and the promise learners see.
admin.createCourseBody: Draft the full workshop — story, ops notes, cover and gallery — and preview desktop, tablet, and phone.
admin.cdnHint: Uploaded to Disrupting Labs CDN (same enteratelo-php stack as athlete-hub, folder domina).
admin.createSavedUploadFailed: Course saved, but an image upload failed — finish images on the course page.
admin.dragOrBrowse: Drag an image here, or browse
admin.imageTypeError: Only JPG, PNG, or WebP images are allowed.
admin.imageSizeError: Each image must be under 4.5 MB.
admin.imageCountError: You can add up to {{count}} images at a time.
admin.titleLegend: 3–200 characters. Shown as the public workshop name.
admin.slugLegend: Optional. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (max 160). Auto-suggested from the title and checked on the server.
admin.slugTaken: That slug is taken. Suggested unique slug: {{suggested}}
admin.slugCheckError: Could not verify the slug. Try again.
admin.categoryLegend: Managed under Catalog options on the Courses page.
admin.levelLegend: Managed under Catalog options on the Courses page.
admin.statusLegend: draft stays private; published appears in the catalog; archived is hidden.
admin.promiseLegend: 4–320 characters. One-line outcome learners leave with.
admin.summaryLegend: At least 8 characters. Short plain-text story of the practice day.
admin.descriptionLegend: Optional rich HTML. Headings, lists, and quotes (max ~200k characters).
admin.minimumLegend: Minimum paid seats before confirming an edition (≥ 1).
admin.audienceLegend: Who the workshop is for. Managed under Catalog options.
admin.cityLegend: Public city. Managed under Catalog options.
admin.catalogBody: Add, rename, or deactivate categories, levels, audiences, cities, and venues used by courses and editions. Deactivated values stay on existing records but cannot be picked for new ones. Tags come later.
admin.catalogKindHint: Soft-deactivate keeps history; nothing is hard-deleted.
admin.catalogVenueHint: Venues include address and city. Used when scheduling editions.
admin.venueLegend: Managed under Catalog options on the Courses page. City comes from the venue.
admin.coverLegend: JPG, PNG, or WebP · max {{mb}} MB · recommended 1600×1000.
admin.galleryLegend: Up to {{count}} photos · JPG/PNG/WebP · max {{mb}} MB each.
admin.previewSummaryFallback: A short story of the practice day.
admin.participantsBody: Every seat across editions — search, sort, and add people manually.
admin.participantsMoved: Rosters and manual adds now live in Participantes.
admin.paymentsBody: Card, OXXO, transfer, and complimentary settlements.
admin.teamBody: Invite staff and company buyers. Welcome email goes out automatically.
admin.legalBody: Edit terms and privacy in Markdown (ES + EN).
admin.descriptionHint: Headings, lists, and quotes to tell the workshop story.
admin.emptyTeam: The team shows up after the first sign-in.
